name: MIP-Splatting
definition: An extension of 3DGS that introduces 2D and 3D Gaussian filters to improve robustness to aliasing caused by resolution changes, focal length variations, or camera distance changes.
summary: MIP-Splatting is an alias-free 3D Gaussian Splatting method that eliminates artifacts by using multi-scale Gaussian selection and 2D Mip filtering.
